_comment: Geometry and feel of the 3D carousel in components/media-gallery.tsx. Everything here is a number you can turn without touching the component. The ring itself is not stored: its radius is DERIVED from the card width and how many cards are on screen (see radiusFor in the component), because a fixed radius would either overlap the cards when there are many or leave a gap when there are few. What the media IS lives in lib/media.ts; this file is only how it moves.

card._comment: Card footprint in px. Every item is the same size or the ring stops being a circle. The mobile pair is used below the `mobileBelow` width.
card._gap: Chord multiplier: 1 packs cards edge to edge, higher pushes the ring wider and opens daylight between them.

stage._comment: perspective is the viewer's distance from the front of the ring: lower is a wider, more dramatic lens. tilt looks down on the ring by this many degrees, which is what makes it read as a carousel rather than a row.

depth._comment: How the far side of the ring recedes. Each is applied in proportion to how far a card has turned away from the front, 0 at dead centre and 1 at the back. fade is how much opacity is lost, scrim is how much darkness is laid over, blur is in px. The backs stay visible on purpose - seeing the whole circle is the point of the thing.

motion._comment: snapMs is the glide to the next card. dragDegreesPerPx converts a drag into rotation; raise it to make the ring spin more freely under the finger. flickFactor is how far a fast flick throws the ring past where it was released.
